correctness.rationale: For every q>=2 the unit vector yields H=2I+4uu^T with exactly 2 and 6. The exact BLOKS block formulas give q unequal active poles plus a common inactive eigenvalue. Rank-one secular interlacing supplies q simple active roots, Jensen gives F(eta_0)<=1-q<0 excluding a collision, and the first active coordinate of each eigenvector is nonzero; together with even e_2 this proves exact CG grades 2 versus q+1. The homogeneous block comparison is an exact eigenvalue calculation. Independently rerunnable exact SymPy checks cover q=2..7 and explicit exact PCG q=2..5. No claim is made that finite tests prove arbitrary q.

value.rationale: The finding directly addresses a recent numerical method whose claimed benefit is iterative kernel-ridge solving. It gives a natural complete extremal statement for a rank-one full-landmark test family: exact two-step CG is changed to q+1-step PCG for a single explicit RHS despite uniformly conditioned original systems, and homogeneous isospectral blocks collapse the preconditioned spectrum to three levels. This distinguishes blockwise leverage geometry from global eigenvalues, gives a reproducible structural benchmark for sketch/preconditioner design, and has arbitrarily large parameter q; the claim deliberately excludes empirical runtime or finite-tolerance slowdown.
